Criterion: Verify that H-bar and FRIES bar provides for the safe insertion and extraction of personnel into and out of the air vehicle. Standard: The design of the H-bar and FRIES bar system allows for safe operation at its maximum and minimum loading conditions, as specified for normal and emergency missions. The system allows for the safe insertion and extraction of personnel for all expected mission profiles. Method of Compliance: The design is substantiated by analysis of components and systems. Component and system tests verify operation, loads and times to be completed as required. Full scale checkouts on a simulator or on the air vehicle verify system installation, rigging, control, and functional performance. Air vehicle flight and ground tests demonstrate compatibility inserting and extracting personnel within air vehicle performance requirements.

versions.title_at_revision: Fast rope insertion and extraction system operation
versions.text:
Standard: The FRIES allows for insertion and extraction of personnel throughout the operating envelope without creating an AW hazard to the air vehicle and without causing harm to crewmembers, passengers, or ground crew throughout the operating envelope. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review of flight manuals verifies that the maximum and minimum loads and flight envelope operating limits (e.g., maneuvering, CG, weight, altitude, bank limits and airspeeds) are defined. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct dynamic and stability analyses to verify the operation of the FRIES (personnel insertion and extraction and rope deployment) does not create an AW hazard impacting flight operations. Fast rope insertion and extraction systems load reactions from insertion, extraction, swinging, and trolling, do not affect the air vehicle during hover, and transition into flight or hover. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
    (1) Flight test: Conduct flight testing of FRIES to verify that all operations do not create effects causing damage to air vehicle systems, loss of control of the air vehicle, harm to crewmembers, passengers, or ground crew, or instability effects due to insertion, extraction, swinging, and trolling. The FRIES operating envelope and limits (e.g., maneuvering, CG, weight, altitude, bank limits and airspeeds) are verified.
